goals.purpose: Search internal registry and PyPI for solubility prediction tools.
acceptance_criteria: At least 3 candidate tools returned with license + maturity info

goals.purpose: Pick the highest-ranked solubility predictor that satisfies policy constraints.
Normalize the input SMILES (e.g. CC(=O)Oc1ccccc1C(=O)O for aspirin) and load solvent parameters for water at 25 C.
acceptance_criteria: Solvent + temperature constraints attached to the run bundle

goals.purpose: Run the selected solubility predictor on the prepared input locally.
Compare predicted log-solubility against the literature baseline value for aspirin in water at 25 C.
acceptance_criteria: Absolute error vs. literature baseline within 15%

goals.purpose: Surface the validated result to the researcher for final approval.

metadata.rationale: Linear discovery -> selection -> prep -> run -> validate -> review pipeline for the molecular-solubility pilot.
